slides.title: 4 syntax tricks that *cut your code in half*
slides.subtitle: Old way vs new way. Swipe and save.

slides.heading: 1. *Inline* declarations
slides.left:
DATA lv_count TYPE i.
lv_count = lines( lt_orders ).

slides.heading: 2. *Table* expressions
slides.left:
READ TABLE lt_mara INTO ls_mara
  WITH KEY matnr = lv_matnr.
IF sy-subrc = 0.
  lv_mtart = ls_mara-mtart.
ENDIF.
slides.right:
lv_mtart = VALUE #(
  lt_mara[ matnr = lv_matnr ]-mtart
  OPTIONAL ).

slides.heading: 3. Fill a table with *VALUE*
slides.left:
ls_item-matnr = 'MAT-01'.
ls_item-menge = 10.
APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.

slides.heading: 4. *String* templates
slides.left:
CONCATENATE 'Order' lv_vbeln
  'saved' INTO lv_msg
  SEPARATED BY space.

posts.caption:
Still writing CONCATENATE and READ TABLE in 2026?

These 4 ABAP 7.40 features cut your code in half and make reviews easier:
1. Inline DATA( )
2. Table expressions itab[ ]
3. VALUE #( ) to fill tables
4. String templates | |

Save this for your next project. Which one do you use every day? Comment the number.
